Roly has lost his best potato, but Duggee finds it using his sense of smell. But what is a sense? Time for the Squirrels to learn about the five senses.
Betty and Sergeant Ant just want perfection, but no one seems to be listening to their shouting. They need a lesson in diplomacy to learn how to speak in a more sensitive way.
Duggee hosts a Buddy Bonanza for Mrs Weaver and the Squirrels, with the aim of finding new buddies with common interests to them.
It’s bridge building time. The Squirrels help a quarreling group of Gerbils sort out their longstanding disagreement.

lista.titulo: Hey Duggee - The Soap Opera Badge
lista.descripcion: After breaking the Chickens' TV aerial during the finale of their favourite soap opera, the Squirrels take it upon themselves to recreate the final episode for them. But will their performance impress the grumpy Chickens?

lista.titulo: Hey Duggee - The Mythical Creature Badge
lista.descripcion: The Squirrels find a hidden book about mythical creatures. They learn and discover a wide range of mythical creatures, create their own and find out why the book was hidden in the first place.
Seven shows the others how to be lucky: ask a number friend to jump on your head! But how do you know which friend? Find out how to tell the difference between two numbers with the Numberblocks.
Ten riders, ten pedal-powered cars, but only one can lift the trophy. Welcome to the Numberblock Rally! Learn about taking away with the Numberblocks.
When Five and friends go missing from the five-star ball, Six to Ten discover they are all Five-and-a-friend! Learn about splitting numbers into smaller numbers with the Numberblocks.

The naughty Terrible Twos are making brainwashing custard pies and Eight is tangled up. Can 1, 2, 3, two 4's, 5, 6, 7 and 8 save the day and stop 4 Terrible Twos making Octonaughty and defeat him and put him in the pie?
The number friends all want to do different things today, so rocket Ten finds a clever way to do them all. Learn all the ways to add to ten with the Numberblocks.
Squarey, we're not in Numberland any more! Four visits Flatland, where the flat shapes live, and becomes a real square. Learn about 2D shapes with the Numberblocks.

lista.titulo: Peg + Gato - Follow The Bouncing Ball
lista.descripcion: Cat chases his favorite ball as it bounces through 10 different worlds to 10 different beats.
Our friends are preparing for a tennis game. Pato is a grand champion and it seems that no one can challenge his superiority on the court. But... is he really the best player?
Pocoyó y Nina están jugando al tenis, pero Pato les cambia la pelota por un balón de baloncesto.
El dormitorio de Elly tiene una cama y un armario lleno de ropa.
Pocoyo, Pato, and Elly ride their favorite vehicles but when Caterpillar also wants to ride with them, she can’t find any vehicle her size.

lista.titulo: Pocoyó - Pocoyo El baño de Elly
lista.descripcion: Pocoyo wants to play ball with Elly but she’s too busy taking a bath with her rubber ducky and brush.

Cuando le toca a Bingo llevarse a casa a César Conejo, la mascota de su guarde, y pegar en un álbum recuerdos del fin de semana, la familia decide dejar las pantallas y enseñarle lo que es pasarlo bien.

Cuando Bingo deja de jugar al juego de espías de Bluey, el objeto con el que quieren controlar a los adultos del parque deja de funcionar bien. ¡Entonces, Bluey se da cuenta de lo importante que es Bingo y tiene que convencerla de que vuelva!
Cuando se ven obligadas a esperar cinco minutos un pedido en la puerta de un restaurante, Bluey y Bingo hacen lo que pueden para divertirse y ponen a prueba la paciencia de su padre.
Jugar a "Las mariposas" en el jardín es divertidísimo hasta que Bluey se va con Judo y deja solita a Bingo. Ahora, a la pobre se le ha roto el corazón y Bluey tiene que hacer las paces con ella.
Cuando regatear con papá va demasiado lejos, Bingo aprende a encontrar su voz de niña grande.
En el cole, Bluey y sus amigos se enfrascan en diversos juegos. Calipso, la profe, tiene a raya a los niños con sus palabras sabias y una canción… A todos excepto a Pretzel.
Oona organises a get-together in the undergrowth with her friends, but things do not go to plan when Mossy brings along an uninvited guest - Fred the Flea.

lista.titulo: Pregunte a los StoryBots - How Do Airplanes Fly?
lista.descripcion: The StoryBots embark on a high-flying adventure to learn how airplanes fly. Kevin Smith guest stars as the superhero Super Mega Awesome Ultra Guy.

lista.titulo: Los Octonautas en tierra firme - Secret Beneath the Snow
lista.descripcion: Paani bundles up underground with a new feathered friend after a snowstorm.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Not So Easy-Greasy
lista.descripcion: Nia is nervous about working with Tess, the fastest -- and bossiest -- crane on Sodor! When Nia's plan for a safe and speedy delivery goes awry and causes Tess' wheels to clog with sand, they recruit handy Sandy to solve their problem. Luckily, Sandy has a new invention to get Tess up and going again: a tanker full of her Super-Slick Easy-Greasy Crane Grease! However, chaos continues to ensue when Nia gets stuck in the mud and the runaway grease spills all over Sodor! In the midst of the madness, Nia learns how to fix her original plan and save Sodor from slipping and sliding!

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - It All Adds Up
lista.descripcion: It is a special day for Harold -- the Northern Lights will shimmer over Sodor at sunset! He cannot wait to share this moment with his engine friends on Lookout Mountain. However, Thomas and the gang have a busy day ahead of them, which is impacted by damage to the Sodor Suspension Bridge. Carly and Sandy warn the excited engines that they should only cross the bridge in case of an emergency -- a rule that is ignored by Kana, Diesel, Nia, AND Thomas! When the bridge finally collapses and prevents them from reaching Lookout Mountain in time, Harold selflessly chooses to help his friends instead of see the Lights. His sacrifice teaches the young engines an important lesson: your actions add up - stay away until it is safe to play.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Bruno's Map Mishap
lista.descripcion: Bruno is beyond delighted -- he has received the gift of an updated map of Sodor from Sir Topham Hatt! He and Thomas can't wait to use it to navigate their busy schedule for the day. But when Kana's speedy whoosh blows Bruno's beloved map up, up, and away, Thomas and Bruno team up with Percy and Diesel to recover it! While searching the island far and wide for Bruno's prized possession, the gang discovers that there is something more important than keeping their schedules -- their friendship!

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Seeking a Safer Sodor
lista.descripcion: After a near-collision rattles their wheels, Percy and Kana enlist the help of Emily to introduce new safety measures all over Sodor. However, their anxiousness about accidents push Percy and Kana to ridiculous extremes that only makes more trouble! When Percy has another accident caused by his off-the-rails safety obsession, he refuses to leave Tidmouth Sheds. When he has to leap into action to help his friends, Percy learns that paying attention to your surroundings is the best way to not have an accident.
Simón y Gaspar preparan una gran sorpresa para el cumpleaños de su madre con la ayuda de su padre.
Simón quiere jugar a las naves espaciales, pero Lea y Fernando prefieren jugar a otra cosa.
Un día con mucho viento, Simón y Gaspar ayudan a Fernando a volar una cometa.
When Cleany falls ill, everyone in Brooms Town pays him a visit and wishes him well. Spooky gets jealous and pretends to be sick.
Mini is excited to get a present from Grandpa Musty, but a mix-up leads to frustration and inspires the Rescue Team to help their friend.
After making an innocent mistake, Helly lies to Jin about a broken invention. Later, a fire at Spooky's puts Helly in danger.
